jobs.description:

Information, Please See

**Join a Mission-Driven Team**

Do you have a heart for service, a commitment to safety, and a desire to

make a meaningful impact? Moody Bible Institute is seeking a**Public

Safety Officer**to help create a secure and welcoming environment for

our students, employees, residents, and guests on our Chicago campus. As

part of our Public Safety team, you will play a vital role in protecting

our community while supporting Moody\'s mission of equipping people with

the truth of God\'s Word.

**About Us**

Moody Bible Institute is a Christ-centered higher education and media

ministry dedicated to equipping people with the truth of God\'s Word.

Through trusted biblical teaching, media, and educational resources,

Moody reaches audiences around the world with the gospel and seeks to

make a lasting Kingdom impact.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to the Chief of Public Safety, the Public Safety Officer is

responsible for maintaining the safety and security of Moody Bible

Institute\'s Chicago campus through proactive patrols, emergency

response, incident management, and community engagement. This role

requires sound judgment, professionalism, and a servant-hearted approach

to serving others.

**What Youll Do**

  • Conduct foot and vehicle patrols to deter and identify security

concerns.

  • Serve as a primary responder to campus incidents, alarms, emergency

calls, and 911 notifications.

  • Assess, manage, and secure incident scenes while coordinating with

emergency responders and city officials.

  • Prepare accurate, timely, and detailed incident reports and related

documentation.

  • Monitor and oversee part-time staff and dispatch operations during

assigned shifts.

  • Enforce campus policies, including parking regulations and access

control procedures.

  • Provide security coverage for campus events and activities.
  • Assist students, employees, and visitors by providing information,

guidance, and support.

  • Issue trespass notices when necessary and respond to unauthorized

access concerns.

  • Provide security escorts, cash transport support, and executive

protection services as assigned.

  • Complete additional departmental duties and special assignments as

directed.

**Key Qualifications**

  • Associate degree or two years of related security, public safety,

law enforcement, military, or customer service experience.

  • Valid driver\'s license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • At least 21 years of age.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in emergency

situations.

  • Authorized to work in the United States without employer

sponsorship.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  • Bachelors degree in criminal justice or a related field.
  • Illinois PERC Card.
  • Illinois FOID Card.
  • Experience responding to fire, medical, or security incidents.
  • Previous security, law enforcement, campus safety, or military

experience.

**Work Environment**

  • This position is based on Moody Bible Institute\'s downtown Chicago

campus and includes both outdoor and indoor responsibilities.

  • Officers regularly patrol campus on foot and in vehicles, respond to

emergencies, and interact with a diverse campus community.

  • The role requires standing, walking, climbing stairs, and working in

varying weather conditions.

**Schedule**

This position follows an overnight shift schedule, consisting of three

12-hour shifts (6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m.) per week, with a rotating fourth

weekend shift as needed.

**What We Offer**

Mission-driven work that impacts lives for Christ.

Supportive and collaborative team environment.

Position Summary
The Campus Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring the security and safety of all students, employees and visitors on the University Campus.

Roosevelt University seeks a full-time Campus Safety Officer at the Chicago Campus for the midnight shift (10:30PM-7:00AM).

This is a union position and will require union membership; health and wellness benefits is provided by the union.

The salary for this position is $19.75/hr.

Title IX Contact Information: Federal Title IX policy requires that all colleges and universities make known the contact information for the person responsible for coordinating its efforts to comply with Title IX regulations. At Roosevelt University, the Title IX Coordinator is Natasha Robinson. Her office is located in the Auditorium Building of the Chicago campus, 430 S. Michigan Avenue, AUD 476B. She can be reached at 312-281-3245 or TitleIX@roosevelt.edu.

Do not contact this email address for inquiries about your job application; if you have questions, you may email hrquestions@roosevelt.edu.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise considerable judgment, discretion and professionalism in managing sensitive situations and/or irate individuals.
  • Excellent organizational, communication (written and verbal), interpersonal skills, observation and attention to detail.
  • Ability to demonstrate a commitment to service excellence by embodying Roosevelt’s core values, mission, and vision in every aspect of the role working with students, faculty, staff, and visitors.
  • A positive and professional demeanor is a must.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and Outlook.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate - $16.50/h-University Park, IL
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Description

Warehouse Associate

  • Schedule:
  • Mon - Fri -Start times: 6am , 7am, 9am
  • Pay Rate: $16.50/hr
  • Availability on weekends: Open

Location: University Park, IL

Job Summary

We are seeking a reliable and hardworking Warehouse Associate to join our team . This position is responsible for unloading shipments, feeding boxes into processing machines, inspecting and sorting materials, and safely operating warehouse equipment, including an electric pallet jack.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, safety-conscious, and able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Unload incoming shipments
  • Move materials throughout the warehouse using an electric pallet jack
  • Feed boxes into designated machines according to production requirements
  • Inspect boxes and separate acceptable products from damaged or defective items
  • Stack, organize, and palletize materials properly
  • Maintain a clean and safe work area
  • Follow all safety guidelines and procedures
  • Report damaged materials, equipment issues, or safety concerns to supervisors

Qualifications

  • Previous warehouse experience preferred
  • Experience operating an electric pallet jack required
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and stand for extended periods
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Basic understanding of workplace safety standards

Physical Requirements

  • Frequent lifting, bending, pushing, and pulling
  • Ability to stand and walk for long periods
  • Comfortable working in a warehouse environment (varying temperatures and noise levels)
